{{nihongo|'''Katsuraki ni Imasu Honoikaduchi Shrine'''|葛木坐火雷神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}}), and under the former {{ill|Shakaku|ja|社格|ko|사격 (신토)|zh|社格|qid=Q10444029}} system it was a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. It is commonly called "Fuefuki Shrine."

=== Enshrined deities ===
Its principal deities are {{ill|Yakusanoikazuchi|Q10892534|qid=Q10892534}} and {{ill|Ame-no-Kaguyama|Q10940849|qid=Q10940849}}, with {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602|lt=Ōhirume-no-Muchi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Takamimusubi|lt=Takamimusubi|UNKNOWN|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|de|Ninigi|eo|Ninigi|es|Ninigi no Mikoto|fa|نینیگی-نو-میکوتو|fr|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|id|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|it|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|ja|ニニギ|ko|니니기|mni|ꯅꯤꯅꯤꯒꯤ-ꯅꯣ-ꯃꯤꯀꯣꯇꯣ|nl|Ninigi|no|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|pl|Ninigi|pt|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|ru|Ниниги но Микото|simple|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|sv|Ninigi|th|นินิงิ โนะ มิโกโตะ|tl|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|tr|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|uk|Нініґі но мікото|vi|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|zh|瓊瓊杵尊|qid=Q1056017|lt=Amatsu-hiko Hono-ninigi-no-Mikoto}}, and Ikohitsuhe-no-Mikoto additionally enshrined. The original deity of Katsuraki ni Imasu Honoikaduchi Shrine was Honoikazuchi Ōkami, while Ame-no-Kagoyama-no-Mikoto was the deity of Fuefuki Shrine. Honoikazuchi Ōkami is also called a thunder deity, but here is worshipped as a fire deity.

=== History ===
=== Overview ===
The date of foundation is unknown; shrine tradition says either in the age of the gods or in the reign of {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|ar|الإمبراطور جينمو|arz|الامبراطور جينمو|as|জিম্মু|az|Cimmu|bcl|Emperador Jimmu|be|Імператар Дзіму|ca|Jinmu|cdo|Sìng-ū Tiĕng-huòng|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر جینمو|cs|Džimmu|de|Jimmu|el|Αυτοκράτορας Τζίμου|eo|Imperiestro Jinmu|es|Jinmu Tennō|et|Jimmu|eu|Jimmu enperadorea|fa|امپراتور جینمو|fi|Jinmu|fr|Jinmu|hak|Sṳ̀n-vú Thiên-fòng|he|ג'ימו, קיסר יפן|hi|सम्राट जिममु|hr|Jinmu|hu|Dzsinmu japán császár|id|Jimmu|it|Jinmu|ja|神武天皇|jv|Jimmu Tenno|ka|ძიმუ|ko|진무 천황|kw|Emperour Jimmu|la|Jimmu|lt|Imperatorius Džinmu|lv|Džimmu|mn|Эзэн Хаан Жиммү|mr|जिम्मू|ms|Maharaja Jimmu|my|ဂျင်းမူ ဧကရာဇ်|nl|Jimmu|no|Jimmu|pl|Jimmu|pt|Jimmu|ru|Император Дзимму|sh|Car Jimmu|simple|Emperor Jimmu|sl|Cesar Džinmu|sr|Џинму|sv|Jimmu|th|จักรพรรดิจิมมุ|tl|Emperador Jimmu|tr|Jimmu|uk|Імператор Дзімму|uz|Jimmu|vi|Thiên hoàng Jimmu|war|Emperador Jimmu|wuu|神武天皇|zh|神武天皇|zh_classical|神武天皇|zh_min_nan|Sîn-bú Thian-hông|zh_yue|神武天皇|qid=Q200188}}. The first documentary appearance is in the ''Buntoku Tennō Jitsuroku'', where in {{ill|Ninju|de|Ninju|es|Ninju|fa|نینجو|fr|Ère Ninju|ia|Ninju|id|Ninju|ja|仁寿|ko|닌주|ru|Ниндзю|simple|Ninju|sr|Нинџу|tr|Ninju|uk|Ніндзю|zh|仁壽 (日本)|zh_yue|仁壽 (日本)|qid=Q1373077}} 2 (852), fourth month, it was granted the divine rank of {{ill|Senior Third Rank|Q11123261|qid=Q11123261}}. According to the {{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|cs|Nihon Sandai Džicuroku|de|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|es|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fa|نیهون ساندای جیتسوروکو|ff|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fr|Nihon sandai jitsuroku|it|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ja|日本三代実録|ko|일본삼대실록|pt|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ru|Нихон сандай дзицуроку|simple|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|zh|日本三代實錄|zh_classical|日本三代實錄|qid=Q1052981}}, on the 27th day of the first month of {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} 1 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), it was granted Junior Second Rank. In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} it is listed as "two seats of Katsuraki ni Imasu Honoikaduchi Shrine in Oshiami District, {{ill|Yamato Province|be|Ямата (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Yamato|ckb|پارێزگای یەماتۆ|cs|Provincie Jamato|de|Provinz Yamato|el|Επαρχία Γιαμάτο|es|Provincia de Yamato|fa|ولایت یاماتو|fi|Yamaton provinssi|fr|Province de Yamato|gl|Provincia de Yamato|hak|Yamato-koet|id|Provinsi Yamato|it|Yamato (provincia)|ja|大和国|ko|야마토국|lt|Jamato žemė|nl|Yamato (provincie)|no|Yamato (provins)|pt|Província de Yamato|ro|Provincia Yamato|ru|Ямато (провинция)|simple|Yamato Province|sk|Jamato (provincia)|sr|Провинција Јамато|th|แคว้นยามาโตะ|tr|Yamato (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ямато|ur|یاماتو صوبہ|zh|大和國|zh_min_nan|Yamato-kok|zh_yue|大和國|qid=Q907495}}," ranked as myojin taisha and receiving offerings for monthly, aidame, and niiname rites. After this, however, references to the shrine disappear. Shrine tradition says the shrine declined in the Heian period and became a {{ill|Massha|Q135009906|qid=Q135009906}} of Fuefuki Shrine in this area.

Fuefuki Shrine is thought to have been founded by the Fuefuki no Muraji clan, who were based here. Its deity Ame-no-Kagoyama-no-Mikoto is their ancestral deity. Behind the honden is an ancient tomb said to be that of {{ill|Taketahori no Mikoto|ja|建多乎利命|qid=Q97706292|lt=Taketawake-no-Mikoto}}, father of Kaiko, ancestor of the Fuefuki no Muraji.

=== Cultural properties ===
=== Nara Prefecture designated cultural properties ===
* Historic site
** Fuefuki Shrine Kofun - designated March 20, 1998 (Heisei 10).
* Natural monument
** Ichiigashi grove of Fuefuki Shrine - designated March 10, 1997 (listed as Shōwa 62 in source).
